text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 9) 2021.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2022.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 1 Januari 2022 hingga 4 Februari 2022.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Tomato

2. Cili merah

3. Sawi hijau

4. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

5. Kacang panjang

6. Timun

Dibuat 28 Disember 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 9) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 9) Order 2021.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2022.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 1 January 2022 to 4 February 2022.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Tomato

2. Red chilli

3. Green mustard

4. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including

Beijing cabbage)

5. Long bean

6. Cucumber

Made 28 December 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
